exercises.name: Chair box squat
exercises.rationale: Knee extension through full range (quads) + hip extension (glutes, secondary). Hamstrings barely change length (biarticular), so 0. Partial depth to a chair.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.rationale: Knee extension through full range (quads) + hip extension (glutes, secondary). Hamstrings barely change length (biarticular), so 0.

exercises.name: Split squat
exercises.rationale: Knee extension through full range (quads) + hip extension (glutes, secondary). Hamstrings barely change length (biarticular), so 0. Front leg does the work; logged per side.

exercises.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat
exercises.rationale: Deep knee flexion (quads) and deep hip flexion stretch the glutes under load, so both are 1 and it counts as lengthened.

exercises.name: Assisted shrimp squat
exercises.rationale: Knee extension through full range (quads) + hip extension (glutes, secondary). Hamstrings barely change length (biarticular), so 0. Hand support on a door frame.

exercises.name: Assisted pistol squat
exercises.rationale: Knee extension through full range (quads) + hip extension (glutes, secondary). Hamstrings barely change length (biarticular), so 0. Hand support on a door frame.

exercises.name: Pistol squat
exercises.rationale: Knee extension through full range (quads) + hip extension (glutes, secondary). Hamstrings barely change length (biarticular), so 0.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.rationale: Unilateral knee extension (quads) + hip extension (glutes, secondary). Hip abductors stabilize only, so 0.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.rationale: Unilateral knee extension (quads) + hip extension (glutes, secondary). Hip abductors stabilize only, so 0.

exercises.name: Chair step-up
exercises.rationale: Knee and hip extension stepping onto a chair: quads and glutes both work hard. Shortened-to-mid range, so not lengthened.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.rationale: Hip extension in a shortened range (glutes). Knee is flexed, so hamstrings are short and minor (0.25). Lower back is isometric, so 0.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.rationale: Hip extension in a shortened range (glutes). Knee is flexed, so hamstrings are short and minor (0.25). Lower back is isometric, so 0.

exercises.name: Shoulder-elevated hip thrust
exercises.rationale: Hip extension in a shortened range (glutes). Knee is flexed, so hamstrings are short and minor (0.25). Lower back is isometric, so 0. Larger hip range than a floor bridge.

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.rationale: Hip extension in a shortened range (glutes). Knee is flexed, so hamstrings are short and minor (0.25). Lower back is isometric, so 0.

exercises.name: Single-leg RDL
exercises.rationale: Hip hinge on one leg: hamstrings work through a long range, glutes extend the hip. Bodyweight only, so lighter than a loaded version; balance limits the set as much as strength.

exercises.name: Nordic curl negative
exercises.rationale: Eccentric knee flexion lowering the whole body: very high hamstring load at long length. Feet hooked under a couch or bed.

exercises.name: Double-leg calf raise
exercises.rationale: Ankle plantarflexion (calves). Nothing else moves under load.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.rationale: Ankle plantarflexion (calves). Nothing else moves under load.

exercises.name: Prone superman
exercises.rationale: Spinal extension (lower back) with a small hip extension (glutes, 0.25).

exercises.name: Table reverse hyper
exercises.rationale: Hip extension from a flexed hip (glutes), with hamstrings and lower back assisting (0.5 each).

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.rationale: Isometric knee extension at about 90 degrees: quads only; holds count in repsEq.

exercises.name: Forward lunge
exercises.rationale: Step forward into a lunge: knee and hip extension on the front leg, with a braking demand.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge
exercises.rationale: Side lunge: quads and glutes on the bent leg, adductors stretched on the straight one.

exercises.name: Curtsy lunge
exercises.rationale: Crossing behind into a lunge puts the front hip in adduction, so the glutes lead.

exercises.name: Fire hydrant
exercises.rationale: Hip abduction on all fours: upper glutes (glute med).

exercises.name: Band squat
exercises.rationale: Squat standing on a band: knee and hip extension, tension rising toward the top.

exercises.name: Band good morning
exercises.rationale: Hip hinge against a band over the neck: hamstrings and glutes extend the hip, lower back holds.

exercises.name: Band glute kickback
exercises.rationale: Hip extension of one leg against a band: glute isolation.

exercises.name: Band lateral walk
exercises.rationale: Side steps with a band around the legs: hip abduction (glute med); quads hold the half squat.

exercises.name: Band leg curl
exercises.rationale: Knee flexion lying face down against a band anchored low: hamstring isolation.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.rationale: Squat holding one dumbbell at the chest: knee and hip extension, upright torso.

exercises.name: Dumbbell sumo squat
exercises.rationale: Wide-stance squat: more adductor and glute involvement than a narrow squat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.rationale: Hip hinge with soft knees: hamstrings and glutes loaded at long length, lower back holds.

exercises.name: Dumbbell single-leg RDL
exercises.rationale: One-leg hip hinge with a dumbbell: hamstrings and glutes at long length, plus balance.

exercises.name: Dumbbell deadlift
exercises.rationale: Hip and knee extension lifting from the floor: glutes lead, hamstrings, quads and lower back share.

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
exercises.rationale: Step back into a lunge holding dumbbells: front-leg knee and hip extension.

exercises.name: Dumbbell walking lunge
exercises.rationale: Continuous lunges holding dumbbells: knee and hip extension with balance demand.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.rationale: Static split stance holding dumbbells: front-leg knee and hip extension.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian split squat
exercises.rationale: Rear foot on a bench: deep front-leg knee and hip flexion, so quads and glutes work at long length.

exercises.name: Dumbbell step-up
exercises.rationale: Stepping onto a bench holding dumbbells: knee and hip extension on one leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
exercises.rationale: Hip extension with shoulders on a bench and a dumbbell on the hips: glutes peak at lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell glute bridge
exercises.rationale: Hip extension from the floor with a dumbbell on the hips: glutes.

exercises.name: Dumbbell swing
exercises.rationale: Explosive hip hinge: glutes snap the hips through, hamstrings load on the backswing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell calf raise
exercises.rationale: Ankle plantar flexion holding dumbbells: calves.

exercises.name: Dumbbell good morning
exercises.rationale: Hip hinge with one dumbbell held at the chest: the long lever loads the lower back and hamstrings, glutes help.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lying leg curl
exercises.rationale: Face down on a bench, a dumbbell held between the feet: knee flexion isolates the hamstrings; calves help at the knee.

exercises.name: Weighted prone back extension
exercises.rationale: Lying face down, a light dumbbell held at the chest, lifting the chest: spinal extension loads the lower back, glutes help.
